title: Holloman footage debunked as an F-4
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Holloman footage debunked as an F-4, about 1970s at White Sands and Holloman, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: But there's also a little bit of footage and that footage has now been debunked as an F4.
This DVD, however, was a gamecher. I quickly fast forwarded to the landing footage and was momentarily stunned by what that extra detail revealed.
tellings.difference: Credits the debunk to the HD DVD release (c. 2024-2025) and calls the object only a plane, not an F-4.
tellings.link_reason: The Holloman landing footage is shown to be an ordinary aircraft. That is the same debunk the story describes.

as_told.title: HD release shows the Holloman 'landing' footage is a plane
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

plain: This story is about film said to show a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico, from the 1970s. The footage appeared in a documentary called UFOs: Past, Present and Future. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that little bit of footage has since been shown to be just an F-4, a military jet. An unnamed documentary narrator, speaking on a later episode, tells how a sharper HD DVD release of the documentary changed things. Fast-forwarding to the landing scene, the narrator says the extra detail was stunning and showed the object was a plane, without saying an F-4. Both are speaking in their own words. The story matters because the footage had been offered as a filmed alien landing at a military base.
